Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application

Class CameraView

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application.CameraView
public final class CameraView extends Object
The immutable camera data an interface may display: a snapshot taken when the view was built, which does not follow later changes to the camera.
